text:
Priya: Heads-up — customer Acme reported UI timeouts; p99 for /v1/generate (model-xlarge, us-west-2) jumped to ~3.8s at 11:07 UTC. Escalation INC-2026-045.
Jamal: Confirmed on Grafana. p50 320ms -> 620ms, p95 410ms -> 1.2s, p99 ~3800ms. Spike starts ~11:06; queueing on pool inference-west-gpu3.
Sasha: Seeing same. KV cache miss rate up ~12%, and one node showing high GPU scheduling latency.
Alex: Quick mitigation candidates: 1) circuit-breaker -> fallback to model-medium-quant, 2) temporary rate-limit on the customer API key, 3) scale the GPU pool, 4) enable prefix KV cache for their routes.
Priya: Agreed. Execute in that order. @oncall-bot create incident and page SRE.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 created and paged.
Jamal: I can apply the throttle now: `curl -X POST https://admin.internal/keys/acme/rate_limit -d '{ "calls_per_min": 50 }'` — running.
Sasha: I'll flip routing fallback: `redwoodctl routing set --model model-xlarge --fallback model-medium-quant --latency-threshold 1000` — applying.
Alex: Scaling pool: `kubectl scale deployment inference-west-gpu3 --replicas=6` — scaling now.
Priya: Enable KV prefix cache for Acme to reduce repeated context fetches: `redwoodctl cache enable --customer acme --prefix /acme/`
Jamal: Throttle applied. Monitoring: p99 dropped from 3.8s -> 2.1s within 30s.
Sasha: Routing fallback active. p95 back to ~480ms, p99 ~900ms. Queue lengths decreasing.
Priya: Support Ops, can you ask Acme for repro steps and sample payloads (context length, streaming flag, batch size)? Need to know if this is a traffic pattern or payload-induced.
Support Ops: Reached out — they sent a large batch with long context and streaming enabled. Sample payload attached to ticket.
Alex: Notes / action items: SRE to investigate node gpu-12 kernel/GPU metrics and eviction patterns; Infra to review autoscale cold-start thresholds and burst capacity; Product to check any model heavy rollout yesterday.
Jamal: Relevant logs snippet:
```
[11:06:58] queue_length=42 p99_ms=3789 pool=inference-west-gpu3 node=gpu-12
[11:07:02] kv_miss_pct=12.4 cache_latency_ms=9.1
```
Priya: Good catch. Immediate mitigations successful — leaving incident open for RCA. p99 now ~720ms and trending down. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: INC-2026-045 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/latency-fallbacks
Alex: We'll schedule an RCA and add a short-term guardrail: auto-enable fallback routing when p95 > 800ms for 2m and auto-throttle keys that exceed burst tokens. I'll create the follow-up ticket.
Priya: Thanks team. Keep posting updates here if anything regresses.
